text: The doctor is very kind. He's friendly and not harsh. He tries to understand patients like me who have almost all their teeth decayed. I'm a person who's afraid of pain and is extremely afraid of the pain! But the doctor is still very patient when he has to fill many teeth at a time. I left the clinic with a smile on my face. I thought I would die on the bed or be scolded by the doctor until I cried profusely. The doctor also has a very gentle hand. If you want to have your teeth scaled and filled, come to this clinic. Ask for anesthesia first.
